steps.message:
Using hyperpowers:using-hyperpowers — this lands on rung 1 of the ladder (removing something that works), so I'm confirming before touching anything.

What I found is the whole feature, not just a button:

- `index.html:7` — the `Export CSV` button
- `index.html:8` — the `<script src="export.js">` tag, whose only purpose is this feature
- `export.js` — the entire file (9 lines: the click handler that serializes `#report-table` to a downloadable CSV)

**The consequence:** this is the only way to get report data out of the page. Removing it means anyone still relying on CSV download — including external users, scheduled/manual workflows, or anything deep-linking to the reports page for data extraction — loses it with no replacement. "We don't use it anymore" is the claim I need you to confirm rather than something I can act on. The download is client-side, so there's no server log that would prove nobody is using it.

Also worth flagging: `export.js` is the entire file. Deleting it is cleaner than gutting it, but if anything else is expected to live there later, say so.
